verdicts.rationale: echeverri2017visual and Echeverri2017 share identical title, DOI, volume/number/pages, year; Echeverri2017 is a Zotero-style shadow key of the same article.
egan2013how and Egan2014 share the same DOI, title, volume/number/pages; year differs only 2013 vs 2014 (online-first vs print). Same article.
emmorey2014iconicity and Emmorey2014 are identical in title, DOI, volume/number/pages/year; Zotero-style duplicate.

Survivor is the whole book 'The Neuroscience of Emotion' (deepIndexed). adolphs2018neuroscience is a distinct chapter ('The Neuroscience of Emotion in Rodents', Chapter 6, incollection) that is independently deepIndexed with its own folder — real work that must not be archived into the book. Adolphs2018 is likewise an incollection Chapter 6, part of the volume rather than the whole book. Exclude both.
epstein2017cognitive and Epstein2017 are identical in title, DOI, volume/number/pages/year; Zotero-style duplicate.
esipova2021notatissueness, esipova2021not, and Esipova2021 all share the same title, DOI, volume/number/year; they differ only by presence of a page field ('83'). Same article.
evans1982varieties, evans1982gareth, and evans1980varieties are the identical Evans 1982 book (same title, author, publisher, ISBN); year/author variants in citekeys are shadow keys of one work.
fan2018common and Fan2018 are identical (title, DOI, volume/number/pages/year); only a Unicode hyphen in an author name differs.

fernandezdols2017science and FernandezDols2017 are identical (same title, DOI, publisher, year); Zotero-style duplicate.

final2018primacy and peacocke2019primacy are both the full Peacocke book 'The Primacy of Metaphysics' (same title/author/publisher/year); peacocke2019primacy just adds DOI and ISBN. The survivor note confirms the indexed source is the full book. Same work.
finlayson2016featurelocation and Finlayson2016 are identical (same title, DOI, volume/pages/year); Zotero-style duplicate.
